# Load & Save data

## Yvalue

```{r}

d0="C:/Users/U108-N806/Documents/STAGE_M2_ROSA_NIRS/VitaSPEC/"

# AG
AG <- read.table(paste0(d0,"vitaspec_R/analyses_ref_csv/Partie 1.2.csv"), 
                 sep=";", 
                 header=TRUE, 
                 dec=",") %>%
  mutate(ech = sub("-.*", "", code_nirs))

# carotène
carot <- read.table(paste0(d0,"vitaspec_R/analyses_ref_csv/Partie 1.3.csv"),
                    sep=";", 
                    header=TRUE, 
                    dec=",") %>%
  select(-2) %>% 
  mutate(ech = sub("-.*", "", code_nirs))

# lip totaiux
tlip <- read.table(paste0(d0,"vitaspec_R/analyses_ref_csv/Partie 1.4.csv"), 
                   sep=";", 
                   header=TRUE, 
                   dec=",") %>%
  mutate(ech = sub("-.*", "", code_nirs))

# eau
meso <- read.table(paste0(d0,"vitaspec_R/analyses_ref_csv/V4_Vitaspec_cpx_meso_M1àM306_fm1_sd_me.csv"), 
                   sep=";", 
                   header=TRUE, 
                   dec=",") %>%
  rename(eau = `TE1...MF.`)
eau <- meso %>% 
  select(ech,eau)

# merge 
Yvalue <- eau %>%
  full_join(AG, by = "ech") %>%
  full_join(tlip, by = "ech") %>% 
  full_join(carot, by = "ech")

# export

write.csv(Yvalue,"C:/Users/U108-N806/Documents/STAGE_M2_ROSA_NIRS/VitaSPEC/vitaspec_R/ROSA_vitaSPEC/Data/Analyses_chimiques.csv",row.names = FALSE)

write_xlsx(Yvalue, "C:/Users/U108-N806/Documents/STAGE_M2_ROSA_NIRS/VitaSPEC/vitaspec_R/ROSA_vitaSPEC/Data/Analyses_chimiques.xlsx")
```

## Xvalue

```{r}
# Load spectra
dirs <- list.dirs(paste0(d0, "spectres/"), recursive = FALSE) %>%
  basename() %>%                     # recup le nom des dossiers
  as_tibble() %>%                    # tibble pour dyplr
  filter(grepl("_Vita", value)) %>%  # on garde ceux avec _Vita
  filter(!grepl("HR", value)) %>%    # on enleve ceux avec HR
  pull(value)                        # retours sous forme de liste 

# merge de tous les campagnes de spectres
Xvalue <- merge(vitaspec_load(paste0(d0,"spectres/"),
                       dirs[1]),
                vitaspec_load(paste0(d0,"spectres/"),
                       dirs[2]),
                by="spname",
                all=TRUE)

for (i in 3:(length(dirs))) { Xvalue <- merge(Xvalue,
                                              vitaspec_load(paste0(d0,"spectres/"),
                                                            dirs[i]),
                                              by="spname",
                                              all=TRUE)}

# clean des spectres sans nom (erreur manip)
Xvalue <- Xvalue %>%
  filter(!grep("Spectrum",
               Xvalue$spname)) %>% 
  mutate(ech = sub("-.*", "", spname),
         rep = as.numeric(substr(spname, nchar(spname)-4, 
                                 nchar(spname))))
  
# ajout colonne "état"
Xvalue <- Xvalue %>%
  mutate(etat = case_when(
    # exo = Pobe et contient X
    (!is.na(x20240325_Vitaspec_Pobe[,1]) | !is.na(x20250224_Vitaspec_Pobe[,1])) & grepl("X", spname) ~ "Exo",

    # meso_frais = Pobe présentes et ne contient pas X
    (!is.na(x20240325_Vitaspec_Pobe[,1]) | !is.na(x20250224_Vitaspec_Pobe[,1])) & !grepl("X", spname) ~ "Meso_frais",

    # Mso_silica = 
    (!is.na(x20240405_VitaSPEC_S_DIADE[,1]) | !is.na(x20250313_Vitaspec_S_DIADE[,1])) ~ "Meso_Silica",

    # meso_Lyoph = 
    (!is.na(x20250319_Vitaspec_Lyoph_DIADE[,1]) | !is.na(x20250321_Vitaspec_Lyoph_DIADE[,1])) ~ "Meso_Lyoph",

    # si aucune condition 
    TRUE ~ NA_character_
  ))

  

```
